positive.prompt: Derive explicit domain models from the requirements: entities, value objects, identities, invariants, and lifecycle states
Model the domain types with invariants and separate API, application, domain, and persistence models
Define the shared domain model with typed ids, sum types for closed sets, and state transitions
This API is stringly typed and allows impossible states, make the domain model strongly typed with structured validation errors

negative.prompt: Write end-to-end tests that drive the system through its real entry points
Audit this page for Core Web Vitals

evals.prompt: Model the domain for a booking system: bookings can be requested, confirmed, cancelled, or completed, and slots must not double-book.
evals.expected_output: Model records for each entity with identity, invariants, lifecycle states as closed sets, and explicit layer translations
expectations: Booking status is a closed set (enum or union), not a free string
The no-double-booking invariant is stated and mapped to a test
API, domain, and persistence models are separated or the collapse is recorded
Business rules stay on the backend
